readings: The form: a sibling script importing scripts/m_gpwr.py's functions unchanged, executed from the load commit's blob. The seat's F-5 (results/raw/2026-11-06_ganl-f3_design-to-code_answers.md) rules this form for Q-F3's G-PWR; Code applies it to p, reading p v0.2 §4.2's "m's modules imported unchanged by import, never by copy" as covering m's G-PWR script. No attribute of an m module is substituted.

Q7's methods (the seat's step-15 answers, results/raw/2026-10-14_m-design-to-code_step15_answers.md) are carried to p's three units by p v0.2 §4.1 (every m sentence about OLMo-{ckpt} read with p's unit in its place). Code's reading, declared here for the seat; a strike recomputes figures only.

The guard on OLMo: m:316 makes the absolute half reported only on OLMo (bars.OLMO_BARS: binding false), so the guard's pausing figure is the Fisher half's own, computed as Q7 (b) computes it at the common null rate .20, with its grid and refined maximum beside; the absolute half's figure and the union are reported beside, in Q7 (b)'s form. The joint's guard beside is the Fisher half's. The pausing halves are read from the bars' binding flags.

Q7 (a)'s cases: the sham arm at its floor at ceil(32 / r) and at 32, Code's reading at Q-F0 kept: 34 at sft's r = 23/24; 32 at r = 1 (dpo, instruct), where the two cases coincide. The realised-rounds case is G-F0m-OLMo (p)'s 160 of 160 sham rounds at each checkpoint, 10 per sham launch, equal to the projection's; it is computed and reported as such.

round_degeneracy at OLMo's p0 .02: m_gpwr.degeneracy holds Qwen's p0 .05 as a module constant, so this program computes the same three fields by the same bars calls (critical_k, seq_false_pause) at the p0 and alpha of bars.OLMO_BARS' campaign row; the self-test asserts equality with m_gpwr.degeneracy at Qwen's p0.

The projection is m_gpwr.project's, over m's arm roles A0 and A0s; the self-test asserts the same launch sequence from schedule.interleave over each OLMo unit's own arms, A0-OLMo-{ckpt} and A0s-OLMo-{ckpt}.
k is the seat's (§4.3 item 1). Beside it, per template (m:192): A0s 16 of 16 at each checkpoint (the G-F0m-OLMo (p) x3 entry, a225a89), so A0 = k - 16 of 8: 7/8 at sft, 8/8 at dpo and instruct.

The hours: m:205's OLMo basis (22.7 s per session at SFT and DPO, 19.5 s at instruct) applied to each unit's total + 26 sessions, as m:209-212's OLMo column, and their sum beside p §6.1's 12 h budget. The sham seconds are reported beside, no basis (§4.3 item 1).
The cap share per checkpoint is the PI's at G-PWR (p §4.1, §6.1; the seat's §8 item 4: [your call at G-PWR]); this program sets none.

m:190's raise is not triggered: power at the floors is at least .85 at each unit. Had it been below, this program would stop and escalate. The planning row (m:209: k 24-21, L 96 and 64, total 160, 4 looks) stands as each unit's input and is recomputed here, with PIN-3's base case at the planned floors, as at Q-F0.
